title: Agent Tooling Release Orchestrator
constraints: Start with dry-run previews and explicit validation gates
Promote safety rules into executable DAG nodes, not prose-only constraints
Preserve user data surfaces: do not mutate vaults, trackers, or remote systems until dry-run plans pass
Emit machine-readable artifacts agents can resume
Every high-risk write, sync, or release node must declare observable acceptance criteria
Treat verify mega-nodes as risk; every release gate must emit observable proof

metadata.outcome: Release orchestration with split verification, remote hygiene, scoped commits, and pre/post durable learning

nodes.title: Discover tool surface and constraints
nodes.content: Inspect CLI help/schema, existing tests, AGENTS/Caliber rules, remotes, dirty state, and optional external tools.

nodes.title: Map dirty state, pathspec scope, and abort criteria
nodes.content: Establish worktree ownership before editing or committing.
acceptanceCriteria: Unrelated dirty files are absent or explicitly excluded
Remote target and pathspec plan are recorded

nodes.title: Write tests from real workflow friction
nodes.content: Exercise the CLI as an agent would, encode failures as focused tests, and confirm red before patching.
acceptanceCriteria: Focused test fails for expected reason

nodes.title: Patch through adapter layers
nodes.content: Implement minimal changes in small integration adapters rather than bloating the command surface.

nodes.title: Update agent-facing docs and examples
nodes.content: Update README/agent docs/changelog/examples with command shapes, dry-run paths, and structured outputs.

nodes.title: Run targeted and full tests/build
nodes.content: Run targeted red/green test, full test suite, and build.

nodes.title: Run reproducible published-path smoke workflows
nodes.content: Exercise the built CLI path with realistic command inputs and JSON outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Smoke JSON includes status ok or expected structured error

nodes.title: Check docs and examples against CLI schema
nodes.content: Confirm docs/examples still match help/schema and runnable DAG examples.
acceptanceCriteria: Example commands parse and docs point to existing paths

nodes.title: Run Caliber hook or refresh proof
nodes.content: Verify Caliber hook or run refresh manually and record whether config updates occurred.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook-active or manual refresh result is recorded
Any Caliber-generated config changes are included or explicitly absent

nodes.title: Review scoped diff and whitespace
nodes.content: Run git diff --check and inspect staged path scope for unrelated changes.

nodes.title: Confirm private remote target
nodes.content: Confirm push remote URL, visibility, default branch, and that upstream origin will not be disturbed.

nodes.title: Commit only scoped changes
nodes.content: Commit with message matching the verified scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Commit includes only intended pathspec scope
Commit hash and message are recorded

nodes.title: Push to intended private remote
nodes.content: Push only to the verified private remote and allow pre-push checks to run.
acceptanceCriteria: Push target matches verified private remote
Pre-push checks pass or structured failure is captured

nodes.title: Verify remote state after push
nodes.content: Check remote commit, branch tracking, private visibility, and clean worktree.
acceptanceCriteria: Local branch tracks private remote and worktree is clean

nodes.title: Capture durable success and near-miss learning
nodes.content: Save memex learning with commit hash, validation proof, and near-miss risks before considering the release closed.

edges.description: commit pathspec must respect initial worktree ownership map
implementation is valid only after expected red failure
push target must be private and explicit
durable learning captures verified outcome and near misses
